headlines.title: SK Hynix Jumps 8% After a 632% Profit Surge and a $45 Billion Shareholder Pledge. Micron and SanDisk Are Riding Along.
headlines.summary: SK Hynix shattered profit records overnight, and the ripple hit Micron, SanDisk, and Western Digital before US markets opened. Whether this premarket surge marks a genuine memory recovery or just a 60 trillion won promise doing heavy lifting is the question every memory investor needs to answer before October 29.

headlines.title: Is Sandisk (SNDK) Cheap Following AI Infrastructure Optimism And SK Hynix Results?
headlines.summary: Sandisk (SNDK) gained about 4% in overnight trading after upbeat results from rival SK Hynix and fresh optimism around AI infrastructure demand linked to Anthropic’s IPO filing. That overnight move comes amid choppy trading for Sandisk, with the 7 day share price return down 4.43% and the 30 day share price return down 26.60%. However, the 90 day share price return is up 28.44% and the year to date share price return is up 374.

headlines.title: MU, SNDK, Neocloud Stocks Extend Gains On Anthropic Boost, SK Hynix Q3 Stunner; Jim Cramer Urges Caution
headlines.summary: Anthropic’s S-1 filing offered investors fresh evidence of the scale of demand for AI computing infrastructure.

headlines.title: Pre-Q1 Earnings: Is Sandisk Stock a Portfolio Must-Have?
headlines.summary: SNDK's Q1 fiscal 2027 earnings outlook points to strong revenue growth, fueled by AI-driven storage demand, higher NAND pricing and expanding Datacenter sales.

headlines.title: Sandisk Stock Has Been Cut Nearly in Half Since June. Should You Buy It Before Thursday's Report?
headlines.summary: With the flash memory maker reporting Thursday, has its stock already priced in a slowdown?

description: Sandisk Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally. The company provides solid state drives for desktop and notebook PCs, gaming consoles, and set top boxes; and flash-based embedded storage products for mobile phones, tablets, notebook PCs and other portable and wearable devices, automotive applications, Internet of Things, industrial, and connected home applications, as well as removable cards, universal serial bus drives, and wafers and components. It sells its products to computer manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers, datacenters, private cloud customers, cloud service providers, resellers, distributors, and retailers through its sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. Sandisk Corporation was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Milpitas, California.
